messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate hitting prod-gateway (edge-proxy) starting ~12:03 UTC. symptom: TLS handshake failures + 502/504. Pager -> @elena :rotating_light:

elena: acknowledged. looking now — hitting dashboards and tailing gateway logs.

elena: grafana -> prod-gateway 5xx spike from 12:02 to 12:10, error class 'tls_handshake_error' up 18x. latency also up.

elena: tailing logs: lots of `x509` errors: "x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid" and "tls: handshake failure". repeating across multiple upstreams.

raj: onc, this looks like signer/intermediate expiry rather than leaf; seeing CA chain validation failures in the logs. Can you paste an example log line?

elena: here's a snippet from edge-proxy stderr:
```

2026-03-15T12:04:12Z proxy[edge] ERROR tls: remote error: tls: bad certificate verifying client cert chain: x509: certificate has expired
```

elena: also ran `openssl s_client -connect gateway-us.redwood.example:443 -showcerts` — the intermediate cert returned by our rotator looks expired. output shows NotAfter: Feb 28 23:59:59 2026 GMT.

maria: who owns the cert rotator job? I thought rotator rotated intermediates last week but maybe wrong env.

sre_lead: rotator is `cert-rotator` in infra namespace, config driven by secrets in vault. maybe the deployment used old signer?

raj: quick mitigation options: 1) fail open client cert verification at edge to restore traffic (risk: briefly disable mTLS). 2) roll a new intermediate/signer and push via cert-rotator. 3) traffic-reroute to region with healthy chain if any. Which is fastest?

elena: customer-impact: several API customers reported 502/504, CS flagged 7 accounts (customer-success). we should avoid fail-open if possible but if customer impact large we may need to.

customer-success: confirmed 7 high-traffic customers experiencing timeouts; support pages show surge of errors. customers are being alerted, but they want ETA.

maria: I can roll a one-off intermediate quickly if we have a current signer key available in Vault. need approvers for immediate rotation?

raj: I'll verify vault key presence. running `vault kv get secret/certs/prod/signer` now.

elena: meanwhile, can we rate-limit TLS handshakes to reduce load on backends? maybe reduce aggressive retries from edge?

sre_lead: good idea. Also start canary: push new intermediate to a single edge replica and test with synthetic requests. if good, ramp.

deploy-bot: Triggered run: cert-rotator rollout (canary) -> cert-rotator-7f6c -> started.

raj: canary complete on edge-01, I validated `openssl s_client` shows new intermediate chain and handshake succeeds.

elena: rolling to remainder. starting staged rollout to 20% -> 50% -> 100% per policy.

deploy-bot: cert-rotator rollout at 20% -> success.

maria: confirm regeneration used new signer (vault key id: svc-sign-2026-03). fingerprint matches expected.

elena: monitoring: 5xx rate falling back to baseline, handshake errors dropping. customers still seeing intermittent errors but much improved.

customer-success: update sent to affected customers: "we identified an expired intermediate cert causing intermittent TLS handshakes; we rotated the intermediate and are monitoring. we'll follow up with postmortem."

raj: final step: ensure older expired cert is removed from any caches / SNI configurations. purge cert caches on edge proxies:
```
for p in $(kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=edge-proxy -o name); do kubectl exec -n infra $p -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/purge-cert-cache; done
```

elena: purge ran, edge proxies returned 200.

sre_lead: oncall handoff: I'm handing this to raj for post-incident validation and postmortem prep. elena, good job.

elena: handing off to raj at 13:15 UTC — notes: root cause: intermediate/signer expired (rotator missed env with older config). Mitigation: immediate regen + cert-rotator canary rollout -> full. Follow-ups: add alert for intermediate NotAfter < 7d, add unit test to rotator to validate Vault key rotation policy, and run a cert inventory script.

raj: ack takeover. I'll own the follow-ups and coordinate with infra/security. Postmortem owner: raj. ETA for draft: EOD.

maria: thanks everyone. logging this incident in incidents ticket: INC-20260315-001.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (reduced 5xx and handshake errors). duration ~1h10m. severity: High -> mitigated.

raj: post-incident notes: will schedule a postmortem review with infra/security and customer-success tomorrow. action items assigned in the ticket.

sre_lead: good containment. we'll include exact timelines and config diff in the postmortem.

elena: closing channel for now, monitoring for 2h. reopen if anything. :white_check_mark:
